integrity: The exact symbolic proof treats all admissible integers and fields. Reproducible finite-field checkers are corroborating tests, not exhaustive for the infinite family or independently performed audit.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary k-linear automorphism groups only; the field contains a primitive (2^h-1)-st root of unity and the twist determinant is nonzero; no assertion about arbitrary perfect evolution algebras or automorphism group schemes. Literature priority may be implicit in more general weighted-graph techniques.
title: Arithmetic splitting criterion for cyclic automorphism extensions of simple evolution algebras
